vision: Warm, nostalgic, and clean: an 81-year-old church lady in her sunlit farmhouse bathroom, hands wrinkled and capable, with white porcelain and white square tiles glowing. Every shot feels like a well-kept 1950s home, with soft daylight, floral apron, and no clutter. The edit moves between Loretta's face as she teaches, extreme close-ups of the toilet's hidden grime, and clean procedure cards. No dirt is shown for shock; it is shown to teach. The palette is white, lilac, chrome, and old wood, with a gentle, honest pace.

secciones.HOOK: Shots of the sparkling toilet bowl and white tiles, then a hero shot of Loretta pinching her nose, face visible, as she calls the viewer to smell. Close detail on the wet brush in its closed holder. Avoid actual bathroom smell or disgusting graphics; keep it clean but pointed.
secciones.REMEMBER: First, a ≤2s clippable reference card to the laundry video over a folded towel. Then hero shot of Loretta speaking, face visible, with folded towels and a clean bathroom behind her. Show the towel loops and the closed brush holder as parallel hiding spots.
secciones.PAIN: Hero shot of Loretta sympathizing, face visible, with a concerned but not scolding expression. Cut to glossy bowl being scrubbed, a flowery spray mist, then back to her hand touching the outside base and hinges. Avoid brand labels on cleaner bottles.
secciones.PROMISE: First a clean full-page shot of page 9 over a white tile background, then a hero shot of Loretta pointing to the page, face visible. Follow with the under-sink shelf and the eight products, medium shot of her hand counting them.
secciones.STORY: Hero shot of Loretta telling the church story, face visible, with a soft slight smile. B-roll of an old church bathroom door, a mop bucket, a closed brush bucket, then hands pulling out a wet brush. Avoid showing any actual filthy brush; keep it suggestive.
secciones.CTA1: Hero shot of Loretta holding the open book to page 9, face visible, then close-up of the link area? No. Show the book on the shelf above the towels, then the card at the sink. Avoid any URL on screen.
secciones.SAFETY: Page 3 of the book as a full-page graphic with the title clear. B-roll of bleach and vinegar bottles separated by a wide gap, then a window opening, a gloved hand labeling a bottle. Hero shot of Loretta saying the rules, face visible, grave but kind.
secciones.SINK: Open cabinet under the sink, camera low and medium. Loretta's wrinkled hand points to each product as she names it: white vinegar, baking soda, blue dish soap, brown peroxide bottle, washing soda, rubbing alcohol, dishwasher tablets, rags, toothbrush, squeegee, pumice stone. Hero shot of her looking at the shelf, face visible at the end.
secciones.M1: Hero shot of Loretta announcing mistake one, face visible, holding the brush. Then close detail of the wet brush dripping into a closed holder, the dark inside, and her hand opening it. Avoid actual stink lines or flies.
secciones.M1A: Over-the-shoulder shot of the page 9 card, then a hero shot of Loretta's hands demonstrating: lifting the seat, laying the brush handle across the rim, lowering the seat lid. Close-up of peroxide soaking the brush head in the holder.
secciones.M1B: Split the screen conceptually: one shot of the toilet bowl being scrubbed only, then a shot of the outside base and holder being wiped. Hero shot of Loretta saying 'My mother would have tanned my hide,' face visible with a rueful smile.
secciones.LOOP: Hero shot of Loretta pointing to the base, face visible, then a slow pan from the toilet bowl to the base bolts. Avoid cutting to the under-rim yet; build anticipation.
secciones.M2: Hero shot of Loretta kneeling by the toilet base, face visible, pointing at the floor seam and bolt caps. Close detail of the grimy seam and the little caps, then a wide shot of her wiping it.
secciones.M2A: Top-down shot of the page 9 card with base section. Hero shot of Loretta's hand spraying vinegar on the base, then wiping with a rag, then drying with another. Show the seam clearly.
secciones.M2B: Montage: close-up of a single spray bottle, a rag folding, the base after wiping. Hero shot of Loretta saying the church story, face visible, with a knowing look.
secciones.LOOP2: Hero shot of Loretta holding up a hand mirror, face partially visible behind it, then a slow tilt up under the rim. Avoid showing under the rim yet; keep it mysterious.
secciones.M3: Hero shot of Loretta with the hand mirror, face visible, then an extreme close-up of the mirror reflecting the brown film under the rim. Show only a clean section of rim after.
secciones.M3A: Close-up of the old toothbrush dipped in a small glass of vinegar, then Loretta's hand reaching under the rim, scrubbing around the circle. A mirror in the other hand. Show the crust coming off on the brush.
secciones.M3B: Hero shot of Loretta standing at the sink with mirror and toothbrush, face visible, saying the Saturday coffee line. Cut to the clean underside of the rim, then a clean toothbrush.
secciones.CTA2: Hero shot of Loretta holding the book, face visible, then a clean QR code card on the screen over her shoulder? Show the phone pointing at the TV screen. The book on the shelf above towels. Avoid showing any URL; use the QR card.
secciones.M4: Hero shot of Loretta lifting the seat, face visible, pointing at the hinges. Close-up of the hinge area with a little gray film, then her fingers wiping it. Avoid unscrewing if not necessary.
secciones.M4A: Top-down shot of the page 9 card hinge section. Hero shot of Loretta's hand spraying the hinges and scrubbing with an old toothbrush, then wiping dry. Show the gap clearly.
secciones.M4B: Close-up of the clean hinges shining. Hero shot of Loretta saying the Harold line, face visible, with a soft smile. Then a quick shot of a field outside the bathroom window.
secciones.LOOP3: Hero shot of Loretta wagging a finger, face visible, promising the dirtiest thing. Slow pan to the flush handle, but do not show the handle yet. Keep tension.
secciones.M5: Hero shot of Loretta pointing to the flush handle, face visible, then a close-up of the handle with a slight smudge. Show a hand flushing, then the same handle being wiped.
secciones.M5A: Top-down page 9 card handle section. Hero shot of Loretta's hand spraying the handle and the stem, then wiping with a dry rag. Close-up of the stem where it enters the tank.
secciones.M5B: Close-up of the handle shining like a new dime, then a wide shot of Loretta making the bed through the doorway, then her back in the bathroom wiping handle. Hero shot of her face as she says the handshake line.
secciones.OTHER: A clean video reference card for the House Hacks peroxide video over a shot of the brown bottle on its own shelf. Show the bottle away from the vinegar, then the bathroom. Hero shot of Loretta pointing to the shelf, face visible briefly.
secciones.BONUS: Full-page shot of page 10, then a close-up of a brown ring at the waterline. Hero shot of Loretta holding a pumice stone, face visible. B-roll of turning off water, flushing, pouring vinegar from a measuring cup.
secciones.BONUS2: Close-up of a wet pumice stone being dipped in a dish of water, then rubbing the ring gently. Show the ring disappearing. A before/after pair of the same toilet rim. Hero shot of Loretta saying the BE CAREFUL line, face visible, serious.
secciones.BONUS3: Hero shot of Loretta holding the pumice stone, face visible, saying the spring and fall schedule. Cut to an exterior shot of the farmhouse with a handyman truck? Maybe not. Show a clean ring, then a phone on the counter? Avoid showing a handyman.
secciones.END: Hero shot of Loretta at the bathroom door, face visible, listing the items on her fingers. Quick cuts to each clean area: brush drying, base, under rim, hinges, handle, ring. Avoid any text overlay; let her count.
secciones.CTA3: Full-page shot of page 9, then page 10, then the book on the shelf above towels. Hero shot of Loretta pointing to the shelf, face visible. Avoid any URL.
secciones.QUESTION: Hero shot of Loretta sitting on the edge of the bathtub, face visible, leaning in as if listening. Show the comments section? No; keep her speaking, maybe with a hand to her ear. Avoid reading comments on screen.
secciones.NEXT: First a clean video reference card for the stainless steel video over a shot of the kitchen refrigerator with fingerprints. Then hero shot of Loretta in the kitchen, face visible, with the rubbing alcohol and a rag. Show the stove and yellow gingham.
secciones.BLESS: Hero shot of Loretta folding a clean white towel, face visible, then placing it on the shelf above the towels. End on the clean, quiet bathroom with the brush drying across the rim and soft light through the window.
